items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Lincoln, but the interviewee (Mary Lou Williams) does not respond or provide any personal anecdote or connection to him in the provided text.

ctx.x: Yes, yes. There was another pianist that had a terrific beat. His name was Lincoln and I'm telling you he could really swing. That's the only pianist that Martha would sing with. She'd grab Lincoln and they'd start singing and then Joe Turner would sing and they had some great sessions there.
This was the time when Martha was supposed to go to Hollywood and she wouldn't leave?
